newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa sold gold, silver to finance restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Degussa sold gold, silver to finance restructuring.

text.p: German metals, chemicals and drugs group Degussa AG said on Tuesday that it had sold 250 tonnes of silver and four tonnes of gold last year and used the proceeds to help finance a major restructuring.

Degussa management board chairman Uwe-Ernst Bufe told a news conference that the group had realised profits of nearly 50 million marks from the sale which were used to finance restructuring in the group's precious metal segment.
Bufe said the restructuring cost some 60 million marks. But he said that the restructuring in that segment was now completed.
